limitations: Protocol/message-level validation only; no physical executability or GUI task-success claims. Mock fixtures are training_eligible=false.
At this local acceptance point CI is configured but has not yet run on GitHub. Later CI evidence is appended to the ledger and STATUS.md.
Teacher/evaluator separation is by streams and strict contracts, not process isolation or semantic proof that images/text contain no privileged information.
Cross-host clock synchronization remains out of scope; live action admission requires a shared declared clock domain.
image_ref is opaque. No real screen capture, image storage, physical hand environment, real-Mac input, or learned policy is provided by this package.
Six initial contracts are implemented; full task-context, semantic-goal and motor-observation runtime components remain future work.
Events are flushed but not fsynced. Hard process termination may leave partial JSONL without a final manifest; no power-loss durability is claimed.
The fixed fixture created_utc is a reproducibility parameter, not the actual experiment execution time.
This record is not included in its own artifact hashes; public integration is identified separately in the ledger.
